description: This is a test source file for the class FineractPartitionJobConfigValidationCondition in the Fineract project. It contains unit tests to verify the behavior of configuration validation logic related to partitioned jobs, specifically testing that the validation correctly detects invalid configurations and passes valid ones.

classes.name: FineractPartitionJobConfigValidationConditionTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of FineractPartitionJobConfigValidationCondition's logic in various configuration scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a mock ConditionContext before each test.

methods.name: testApplicationStartup_ShouldApplicationStartupFails_WhenConfigurationNumbersAreBelowOne
methods.description: Tests that the validation logic detects invalid configuration where partition size or thread pool sizes are below 1.

methods.name: testApplicationStartup_ShouldApplicationStart_WhenConfigValid
methods.description: Tests that the validation logic passes when provided with a valid configuration.

methods.name: getValidConfig
methods.description: Constructs and returns a valid FineractPartitionedJob configuration object.

methods.name: getBelowOneConfig
methods.description: Constructs and returns an invalid FineractPartitionedJob configuration object with partition size and thread pool sizes below 1.
